source.description: Reviewed handmade raster felt-tip-marker process contact sheet.
source.notes: One face-free upright hourglass with flowing sand; no lettering, numerals, labels, arrows, UI, signatures, watermarks, hands, second timer, sticker edge, badge frame, or decorative border.

process_strategy: Eight cumulative panels move from a sparse center axis, cap guides, glass route, pillar anchors, sand placements, and shadow to one stable hourglass with a complete marker map and a finishing-only final.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using one upright center axis, two wide cap guides, one open glass-waist route, two pillar ticks, three sand placements, and one broken shadow route.

anchor_map.early_mark: One upright center axis with one wide top-cap guide and one wide bottom-cap guide
anchor_map.becomes: One centered hourglass with matched top and bottom caps
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The two caps remain equal in width, parallel, and centered on the same vertical axis and baseline in every panel.
anchor_map.construction_note: Pale open guides only in Panel 1; the cap silhouettes close in Panel 2.

anchor_map.early_mark: One open pinched-waist route between the caps
anchor_map.becomes: One transparent glass vessel with two rounded chambers joined at a narrow center neck
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: Both glass sides attach inside the same cap edges and meet at one centered waist without shifting width or direction.
anchor_map.construction_note: Open route only until the glass contour is shaped in Panel 3.

anchor_map.early_mark: Exactly two side-pillar ticks and three sand placements
anchor_map.becomes: Exactly two outer frame pillars plus one upper sand bed, one centered falling stream, and one lower sand pile
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: Each pillar connects the same top and bottom cap ends; the sand remains inside the glass with the stream centered over the lower pile.
anchor_map.construction_note: Ticks and placements only until the pillars are wrapped in Panel 3 and the sand is shaped in Panel 4.

final_elements.name: hourglass cap glass pillar sand and shadow placement guides
final_elements.description: One center axis, two cap guides, one glass-waist route, two pillar ticks, three placement dots, and one broken ground route.

final_elements.name: matched top and bottom cap silhouettes
final_elements.description: Two equal rounded rectangular caps centered on one upright axis.

final_elements.name: pinched glass vessel and two attached side pillars
final_elements.description: One transparent two-chamber glass contour and exactly two outer pillars attached between the caps.

final_elements.name: upper sand bed falling stream and lower pile
final_elements.description: One curved upper sand bed, one narrow centered falling stream, and one rounded lower sand pile inside the glass.

final_elements.name: two glass highlights three sparkles four cap notches and broken shadow
final_elements.description: Exactly two open-paper glass highlights, exactly three four-point sparkles, exactly four small cap notches, and one broken navy shadow.

final_elements.name: black marker and complete teal coral yellow pale-aqua and navy color map
final_elements.description: Thick imperfect black outlines with teal caps, coral pillars, yellow sand and sparkles, pale-aqua glass accents, and navy notches and shadow.

final_elements.name: directional marker texture glass depth and small frame accents
final_elements.description: Visible marker streaks, established glass depth, sand texture, cap edges, pillar accents, highlights, and shadow texture.

overlap_reservations.foreground_element: pinched glass vessel and two attached side pillars
overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The cap silhouettes stop at the glass and pillar anchors so all four attachments fill reserved spaces without erasing cap keeper lines.

overlap_reservations.foreground_element: upper sand bed falling stream and lower pile
overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The glass interior stays blank at all three sand placements; no decorative keeper line runs through the future sand shapes.

rejection_checks: Reject a detailed first panel, drifting center axis, unequal cap widths, or a glass side or pillar that floats, swaps sides, changes count, or changes attachment.
Reject missing or extra hourglasses, caps, glass chambers, pillars, sand beds, streams, piles, highlights, sparkles, notches, or shadows after those elements appear.
Reject any lettering, numerals, clock face, character face, hands, second timer, sticker edge, badge frame, or prop in any panel.
Reject vector-like fills, glossy poster rendering, repeated faint-to-dark tracings, labels, arrows, numbers, text, signatures, or watermarks.
